changes.title: Opening rest
items: The new opening, step four (?opening=chart): out through the house to her decks, E there plays her DJ intro and that starts the party (no party spell); later loads have a shorter wake-up (any key and she's up); after the bed she wakes in her bedroom again; Controls are on the pause page

changes.title: Packs on
items: Pack combat is now on for everyone: animals of one kind fight you together as a pack, glowing all at once just before they strike, then one lunges while the others fire where you'd dodge to and one throws its kind's special move

Each kind has its own trick: wolves and hares howl for everyone to strike at once, foxes fake an attack, stoats and bats spin you round, moles and moths kick up clouds that hide their tells, ravens fill the air with mirage birds that soak up your 💌s, hedgehogs, boars and woodlice roll at you, badgers and beetles shield a hurt packmate, dormice and otters heal each other, and herons blink in after you when you dodge
Between attacks a pack falls back its own way (up the trees, underground, into a shell, round in a circle) before it comes again, and your own pack of animals combos the same way without the retreats
You can still switch pack combat off on the pause page

changes.title: First load art
items: The first load on a new browser is much quicker: the art is drawn on all your cores at once, she and the treehouse come first, and the creatures and scenery finish drawing while you play, fading in
